thesis: Retired 2026-10-09. HIP-3 lists one name on several builder books with independent oracles and funding, and the funding differences are real (a median 18-69% a year apart), but held to a rule chosen before 2026-09-10 the nine pairs lost 18.4% a year out of sample (t -2.99): the differences flip faster than two round trips on thin books pay for.
